sample_unit: tasks on deidentified clinical documents (discharge letters, clinical notes, EHR data)

links.outcome: Hallucination rate in clinician-reviewed medical text translation outputs
links.effect: Meditron3-Phi4 performed worst in translation, with clinician review identifying hallucinations in 55% of its outputs.
links.quote: For medical text translation, Phi4 ranked highest in embedding-based evaluation, whereas Meditron3-Phi4 performed the worst, with clinician reviews identifying hallucinations in 55% of its outputs.

links.outcome: Clinician ratings of LLM clinical decision support and patient-friendly summaries
links.effect: Clinician ratings generally ranged from dissatisfied to neutral; no model achieved consistently satisfactory performance.
links.quote: In the tasks of generating patient-friendly discharge note summaries and clinical decision support, clinician ratings generally ranged from dissatisfied to neutral, and no model achieved consistently satisfactory performance.

unlisted_practices: Deploying small open-source LLMs locally to keep patient data on premises
Comparing LLM performance against a fine-tuned non-generative baseline (RoBERTa) for deidentification

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of small open-source LLMs across real clinical French hospital records with clinician evaluation, evaluating local validation and assessment frameworks before clinical deployment.
